literal: Having examined deeply, if the mind perceives that which is real, certainly again to think of birth is not needed.
translation: If the mind investigates deeply and realizes the ultimate reality, there is absolutely no need to think of rebirth again.
modern: மனம் ஆராய்ந்து மெய்ப்பொருளை உணர்ந்தால், மீண்டும் பிறப்பைப் பற்றி நினைக்க வேண்டியதில்லை.
explanation: This couplet explains the ultimate benefit of realizing the truth. When the mind investigates deeply and perceives the true nature of reality, it attains liberation. Consequently, there is absolutely no need to experience or contemplate rebirth ever again. The word 'உள்ளது' refers to the ultimate reality or truth, and 'ஓர்த்து' emphasizes the role of deep, critical inquiry in reaching this realization.
